title: The particle 了
simpleExplanation: 了 indicates that an action has been completed or that the situation has changed.
technicalExplanation: There are two 了: the aspectual one (after the verb, completed action) and the modal one (end of sentence, change of state or current relevance). They can co-occur. 了 is not a «past tense»: it also appears in completed futures.
usage: 我买了一本书 (I bought a book); 下雨了 (it started raining).
avoidWhen: It is not used with habitual states nor with verbs like 是, 在, 喜欢 in their normal usage.

title: Action in progress with 在
simpleExplanation: 在 before the verb expresses that the action is happening now: «to be doing».
technicalExplanation: 在 marks progressive aspect. It can be reinforced with 正 (正在) and with final 呢. It should not be confused with the locative 在.
usage: 我在学习 (I am studying); 他在打电话 (he is calling).
avoidWhen: Not with states: do not say 我在知道.

title: Wanting: 要 vs. 想
simpleExplanation: 想 is «I'd like to» (soft desire); 要 is «I'm going to / I want» (firm decision).
technicalExplanation: Both are modal verbs. 要 implies resolute will or necessity and can indicate immediate future; 想 expresses desire or tentative intention and admits gradation (很想).
usage: 我想去中国 (I'd like to go); 我要一杯咖啡 (I want a coffee, ordering it).
avoidWhen: In the negative, «not want» is usually 不想; 不要 means «you must not / don't».

title: Can: 会, 能 and 可以
simpleExplanation: 会 = learned skill; 能 = capability or possibility; 可以 = permission.
technicalExplanation: These are three possibility modals with nuances: 会 (acquired skill: languages, swimming), 能 (physical conditions or circumstances), 可以 (authorization or suggestion). In the negative, denied permission is usually 不能.
usage: 我会说汉语；今天我不能来；可以进来吗？
avoidWhen: Do not use 会 for permissions nor 可以 for skills.

simpleExplanation: 过 after the verb means «to have done something at least once».

title: Comparisons with 比
simpleExplanation: 比 compares: A 比 B 大 = «A is bigger than B».
technicalExplanation: Superiority comparative structure. The adjective is bare or with a degree complement (多了, 一点儿); never with 很/非常.
usage: 今天比昨天热。他比我高一点儿。
avoidWhen: Do not add 很: 他比我很高 is incorrect.

title: Cause and effect: 因为…所以…
simpleExplanation: «Because A, therefore B». In Chinese both conjunctions often appear together.
technicalExplanation: Correlative causal construction. Unlike English, it is natural to keep both conjunctions; one may be omitted in informal register.
usage: 因为下雨，所以我不去了。
avoidWhen: Avoid literally translating «because» at the end of a sentence as a short written response.

title: The use of 呢
simpleExplanation: 呢 returns the question («and you?») or softens an action in progress.
technicalExplanation: Modal particle with two main uses: elliptical question (我很好，你呢？) and continuative nuance with 在…呢.
usage: 你呢？他在睡觉呢。
avoidWhen: It does not replace 吗 in complete yes/no questions.
